title: Semi-automated quantification of microglial CD68 and Iba1 immunohistochemistry signal
author: Amandine Even
materials: Convert images to TIFF format in batch using Zen software. Processing - Batch Batch Method: OME TIFF-Export Method Parameters: see Figure 1 Figure 1
Import data into GraphPad Prism and generate plots.
Train the segmentation AI on NIS-Elements software to detect and count the microglia as described here .
Link the generated AI within the GA3.

steps.title: Prepare Brain Sections
steps.instruction: Section the mouse brain into 40 µm coronal sections and collect one section out of every six for immunohistochemistry.

steps.title: Perform Immunohistochemistry Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the sections for DAPI, Iba1, CD68, and TH (tyrosine hydroxylase) using appropriate primary and secondary antibodies.

steps.title: Define Regions of Interest (ROI)
steps.instruction: Define ROIs per hemisphere using a 5x pre-scan, selecting three striatal coronal slices per brain based on specific anatomical landmarks.

substeps.instruction: Select the first slice where the corpus callosum from both hemispheres is nearly touching.
Select the second slice where the anterior commissure forms a straight line.
Select the third slice including the hippocampus.
Capture reference screenshots of the selected regions.

steps.title: Acquire Images
steps.instruction: Acquire images using a 40x objective with laser excitation at 405, 488, 546, and 647nm.

substeps.instruction: Scan sections to obtain 20 Z-stacks with Z-steps of 1µm.

steps.title: Process Image Files
steps.instruction: Convert images to ND2 file format for analysis in Nikon NIS software.

substeps.instruction: Remove out-of-focus planes from each Z-stack if necessary.
Retain at least 15 planes per Z-stack and ensure all images contain the same number of planes.

steps.title: Deconvolve Images
steps.instruction: Deconvolve all images using the Automatic function in BatchDeconvolution 6.10 NIS software.

steps.title: Configure Quantification Parameters
steps.instruction: Set all thresholds and filters on multiple representative images.

steps.title: Perform Automated Quantification
steps.instruction: Execute automated quantification using the GA3 'Iba1_and_CD68_-_only_EDF' on NIS-Elements software.

substeps.instruction: Verify the accuracy of each step visually after AI processing or batch macro analysis.

steps.title: Organize Data
steps.instruction: Order the resulting data from the csv file in Excel.
